slices.focus: Savings thin as sister's costs and Min-seo's pay cut stack up.
slices.summary: Jae-hyun's sister passes a civil service stage but needs interview clothes and transportation costs, coinciding with Min-seo's clinic reducing incentive pay. Jae-hyun covers more shared expenses while savings stay stubbornly thin. He plans a structured check-in with Min-seo using a three-category note (normal costs, temporary extra costs, family support) to distinguish temporary burdens from structural problems.
open_loops: Defined end date for temporary expense shifts
decisions: Jae-hyun's savings stayed thin because higher housing costs were joined by helping his sister through the next civil-ser
